feeds.description: Find Chicago wedding ideas, Chicago wedding vendors and Chicago party professionals to plan your event in style! Plus, see photos of real Chicago weddings, find expert wedding planning advice and more in our blog! Chicago Style Weddings have seen it all. We are a group of magazine publishers who now work together to share our knowledge and love of all things weddings.

feeds.title: Nikki Kate Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Nikki - a wedding photographer by profession. See the latest weddings and engagements photographed by me on my blog. My job is to capture the true heart of your best day. I am passionate about people and have the greatest joy in telling their stories through photographs.

feeds.title: Winterlyn Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Winterlyn and I am a Illinois Wedding Photographer, Elopement & Portrait Photographer based in Chicago, IL . My blog is where you can view an entire wedding day, engagement session or portrait session from start to finish. I would love for you to see how I have captured the essence of my clients and the details of their day.

feeds.title: Emma Mullins Photography Blog
feeds.description: Blog entries from documentary wedding photographer Emma Mullins Photography, including weddings and engagement sessions in Chicago

feeds.title: Ebby L Photography Blog
feeds.description: I'm Ebby, a wedding + engagement photographer based in Chicago. You'll see weddings, read love stories and even see a handful of personal posts. This blog is one of my favorite aspects of my job. I stumbled upon photography in high school and specifically wedding photography in college. I had that 'a-ha' moment during my first year photographing weddings and knew I wanted to this for years and years to come!

feeds.title: Mackenzie Maeder Blog
feeds.description: Hey friends! I'm Mackenzie, the owner of this proud little business.! I LOVE connecting with people and creating imagery that is real and reflective of you. So you won't find any awkward stiff posing here. Just a lot of fun moments and photos with heart.

feeds.description: Check out the blog for the latest romantic, vibrant, authentic wedding photos. I'm the Jill in JTP.
